Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

response.text:
3-position enabling device | has | 3 switch positions: off, on, off | | A 3-position enabling device 9 has 3 switch positions: off, on, off (in order of actuation when squeezing).
3-position enabling device | is in state | off | when released completely | When released completely, the device is off.
3-position enabling device | is in state | on | in manual mode, when pressed/squeezed to the centre position | In manual mode, when pressed/squeezed to the centre position, it is on.
Completely pressing enabling device | results in | off state | | Completely pressing (squeezing) results in an off state.
Motion | is enabled | when 3P enabling device is ON | | When the 3P enabling device is “ON”, motion is enabled.
SF18 input LOW | triggers | SF2 | | SF18 Input is LOW, ... SF2 is triggered internally
External enabling device connection OFF in manual mode | triggers | SF2, a Stop Category 2 (SS2) | in Manual Mode | When in Manual Mode and when an external Enabling Device connection is OFF, internally the safety system initiates SF2, which is a Stop Category 2.
SF19 outputs | are | HIGH | in Automatic Mode ("running") | In Automatic Mode ("running"), SF19's outputs are HIGH.
Enabling device in Safety OFF state | triggers | SF2, a Stop Category 2 (SS2) | in Manual Mode, enabling device released or fully pressed | In Manual Mode and when any Enabling Device is in the Safety OFF state (not in the centre-ON position, meaning the enabling device is released or fully pressed), a SF2 is triggered causing a Stop Category 2 (SS2)
SF19 outputs | are | LOW | in manual mode, 3PE in the Off state, not Freedrive | In manual mode, when the 3PE is in the Off state, the outputs are LOW and SF2 is triggered
SF19 outputs | are | HIGH | Freedrive activated and ALL 3PE in OFF state | If Freedrive is activated and ALL 3PE are in the OFF state, SF19's outputs are HIGH.
SF19 outputs | are | LOW | Freedrive activated and any 3PE in ON state | Any 3PE is in the ON state, SF19's outputs are LOW.
SF19 outputs | are | HIGH | Freedrive not activated and ALL 3PE in ON state | If Freedrive is not activated, and ALL 3PE are in the ON state, SF19's outputs are HIGH.
